classification.rationale: The garment is a knitted boys' T-shirt of heading 6109. Because the fabric is exactly 50% cotton/50% polyester with no single material predominating by weight, Section XI Note 2(A), incorporated into apparel classification by Additional U.S. Rule of Interpretation 1(d), requires classification as if consisting wholly of the material whose heading occurs last in numerical order among those equally meriting consideration—here, man-made fibers (6109.90) rather than cotton (6109.10). This approach mirrors CROSS ruling H81821, which classified an analogous 50/50 cotton/polyester knit shirt under the man-made-fiber-based subheading. The statistical suffix for 'Boys'' under 6109.90.10 completes the classification.
